messages:
sri: heads-up — noticed a regression on canary: comm/compute overlap disappears when CUDA graphs are enabled + KV prefetch. latency spikes and all-reduce sits idle for long periods.

aj: ugh, repro steps? which commit / model config?

sri: can repro on tp=4, pp=1, batch=8, kv_prefetch=on, cuda_graphs=enabled. Happens after ~200 steps. root cause looks like stream ordering changes during kernel selection fallback.

maria: do you have perf traces? nvtx or CUPTI dump?

sri: pasted a small capture snippet:```
[GPU0] 0.00s kernel: forward_attn (stream=3, captured_graph=true)
[GPU0] 0.12s kernel: allreduce (stream=1, captured_graph=false) WAIT 0.45s
[GPU0] 0.57s kernel: kv_prefetch_copy (stream=3, captured_graph=true)
[GPU0] 0.60s kernel: fallback_kernel_select (stream=0, captured_graph=false)
```

chloe: interesting — fallback_kernel_select running on default stream could be synchronizing the graph stream implicitly if it's using CUDA graph replay path that expects stream serialization. do you see any cudaStreamWaitEvent/cudaEventRecord pairs?

sri: yes, adding that:```
cudaEventRecord(e, stream=3)
cudaStreamWaitEvent(stream=0, e) // happens in kernel selection path
```

aj: that explains it — kernel selection path is touching the default stream which blocks captured streams. Why does kernel selection run on stream 0? should be per-stream or async.

maria: I also see this in perf-bot traces: perf-bot: "allreduce stall time increased 4.8x when cuda_graphs=true + kv_prefetch=true"

tim: quick workaround: set `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=0`? or disable graph capture for the selection path?

sri: temporary mitigations that helped in local repro: 1) disable kernel selection fallback (force preselected kernels), 2) run kernel selection on a low-priority non-default stream, 3) turn off cuda graphs for now.

chloe: long term we should avoid any default-stream sync in hot code paths. options: make kernel selection non-blocking (enqueue a callback on the capture stream), or ensure any event waits are on the same capture stream. also consider using `cudaStreamAttachMemAsync` style ops instead of global sync.

aj: could this also interact with NCCL's stream usage? if NCCL ops are on a different stream they may be waiting on those events and exacerbate stall. need a trace that includes NCCL APIs.

maria: i'll run a full cupy/CUPTI trace and include NCCL timeline. sri — can you attach the canary config + minimal repro script?

sri: attaching gist link (private): https://gist.redwood/sri/repograph — includes a small repro that toggles kernel selection fallback. note: repro is flaky under qemu/gpu-share, good on dedicated devbox.

perf-bot: [auto-report] captured 3 traces, top cause: "cross-stream event wait between kernel-selection and captured graph"; suggested tags: perf, cuda-graphs, kv-prefetch.

aj: next actions: 1) get CUPTI + NCCL traces (maria) 2) instrument kernel selection to avoid default-stream waits (chloe + maria) 3) add test in runtime that runs graphs + kv_prefetch under tp=4 to catch regressions in CI (aj)

sri: i'll keep running canary and post updates. thanks! :thumbsup:
